correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction: for odd p unramified, the ratio of characteristic roots has rank rho dividing p−chi and LTE gives p-parts on multiples of rho; for odd ramified p>=5 ramified p-adic lifting gives U p-part=p^vp(n), V part1; at p=2 parity/doubling gives both explicit formulas. Möbius transforms have index support only at rho p^j for U or t p^j and 2t p^j for V; the witness index rho p forces the exact repair ratio rho/gcd(rho,p−1), and negative companion transform appears at 2t. At p=2 witnesses at indices 2,3,6 yield exact repairs/signs. Inert Frobenius sign forces companion rank parity, and two independent quadratic characters yield prime densities 1/2 and 3/4. The standalone verifier ran successfully for 280 parameter-prime cases through n=200. Prime-density theorem and all-index claims are established by proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: Complete positive-parameter Q=-1 Lucas family classification answers the motivating generalization issue and adds exact minimal integer Dold repair for both members, odd ramification treatment, uniform dyadic distinctions, and a sharp companion sign criterion. Uniform prime densities for an infinite family and unexpected inert p≡1(mod 4) companion behavior are motivated by the natural Lucas local prime-parts question; not a parameter swap or arbitrary finite slice. Valuation lemmas are prior and correctly acknowledged; no claims for general Q or realizability-prime density.
